sequence_description: Token exchange freshness: perform a control token exchange with a valid subject_token, then attempt exchange with an expired subject_token (exp in the past). Expired token should be rejected.

sequence_description: I2 anti-replay: obtain an upstream OIDC id_token via authorization-code flow (control), exchange it once, then re-authenticate (new session) and attempt to exchange the SAME upstream id_token again to see if Dex incorrectly treats it as a one-time artifact or incorrectly allows reuse beyond intended lifetime semantics.
description: [LLM-Judge] Token exchange succeeded even though the control upstream authorization-code flow failed to produce an upstream id_token, so the test cannot substantiate an I2 anti-replay conclusion and suggests the exchange may not be bound to the intended upstream artifact.
